static_evidence_items.content: Chief complaint: bilateral nasal obstruction, thick nasal discharge, and facial pain and pressure
Previous treatments: 3 prior surgeries, immunotherapy, and medical therapy
Symptom recalcitrance: condition recalcitrant to previous treatments
Post-procedure examination finding: binocular horizontal diplopia with left lateral gaze
Post-procedure examination finding: inability for the left eye to track beyond the midline
Post-procedure examination finding: left eye was not proptotic, ecchymotic, or tense
Bedside intraocular pressure measurements: 15 OD, 16 OS (normal)
National Institutes of Health stroke score of 1
Workup results were negative for a cerebrovascular accident
